scripts.test:rules: npx -y firebase-tools@15 emulators:exec --project demo-code --only firestore "node --test tests/firestore.rules.test.mjs"

scripts.test:invitations: node --conditions=react-server --import tsx --test tests/access-email.test.ts && NODE_ENV=test npx -y firebase-tools@15 emulators:exec --project demo-code --only auth,firestore "node --conditions=react-server --import tsx --test tests/account-invitations.test.ts"
